title: BikeMaster Deluxe Helmet Stand
features: Heavy-duty steel construction for long-lasting durability
Adjustable height and angle to fit various helmet sizes
Non-slip rubber base prevents sliding on any surface
description:
Engineered to withstand harsh ultraviolet radiation and dense condensation, the BikeMaster Deluxe Helmet Stand from BikeMaster elevates visual clarity across demanding weather conditions. Built with Hydrophobic Rain-Shedding Exterior Coating with Perimeter Airtight Seal, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Toolless quick-release pivot lever swap in 10 seconds).

The BikeMaster Deluxe Helmet Stand is an essential visual clarity upgrade from BikeMaster. By delivering edge-to-edge optical fidelity and bulletproof fog prevention, it dramatically improves situational awareness across unpredictable climates.
